posts.title: Privatized Patient Transport in the NHS
posts.description: I am being discharged from hospital today after three months admission. But my transport home is now over 4.5hrs late and I am not yet even allocated a vehicle. I remain taking up a bed on the ward at the expense of the NHS. Meanwhile, this is what private outsourcing of transport does to the NHS:

posts.title: Unspoken Agreements, Circling Vultures, and Asahi Linux
posts.description: Asahi Linux is an incredible project. A group of extremely talented low-level hardware reverse engineers have spent years figuring out in reverse how Apple’s System on Chip (SoC) ARM64 devices work; how they can bring up an environment suitable for the Linux kernel on such devices; and then how the peripheral components, designed from scratch uniquely for Apple, work on these M series devices.
